description.en: Montana Department of Revenue Homestead Reduced Tax Rate lowers the classification rate for owners who occupy a Montana home as their principal residence for at least seven months per year, own it personally or through a grantor revocable trust, stay current on property taxes, and enroll for the tax year. Distinct from a homestead declaration filed with a county clerk. No income ceiling for the standard homestead reduced rate.

eligibility_rules.notes: MT Homestead Reduced Rate (MCA 15-6-405 / revenue.mt.gov): principal residence ≥7 months; owner or grantor revocable trust; current on taxes; one homestead claim. Tiered rates by market-value band are published for the tax year — do not hard-code brackets. max_annual_income null; implies_low_income false. Separate from income-tested PTAP.
eligibility_rules.verify_notes: 2026-09-24: Confirm enrollment window and live rate brackets on homestead.mt.gov and revenue.mt.gov Homestead FAQs before advising amounts.

benefits.en: Lower property-tax classification rate on the enrolled principal residence compared with standard Class 4 residential rates (tiered brackets as notified for the tax year).

description.en: Montana University System Honor Scholarship is a renewable tuition-waiver scholarship for eligible Montana high-school graduates attending an eligible MUS / community-college campus. Official MUS pages describe a multi-year tuition waiver (average value commonly cited around $5,000/year at four-year campuses — VERIFY live), merit criteria (GPA, rigorous core/IB, ACT/SAT), Montana residency, and application via Award Montana / scholarships.mus.edu. No family-income ceiling.

description.en: Vermont Department of Taxes Property Tax Credit helps eligible homestead owners with property taxes. Filers must declare a homestead, meet domicile/ownership/occupancy rules, and have household income within the annually published maximum (Tax Year 2025 maximum household income $115,400 on tax.vermont.gov — VERIFY live for the claim year). Credit caps for education and municipal portions are published annually.

eligibility_rules.notes: VT Property Tax Credit: homestead declaration + household income ≤ published annual maximum. Encoded max_annual_income 115400 for TY2025 figure shown on tax.vermont.gov WITH verify=true (updates each year). implies_low_income false — ceiling sits in middle-income homeowner range, not a poverty-only program. File HS-122 + HI-144.
